clone_rl_model: clone an RL model with args, step, and state_dict to a new GPU
save_rl_model: save an RL model state dict, step, and args to a file with retries
load_rl_model: load an RL model from a file with optional keys to omit
load_from_model: load state dict and step from an existing RL model instance
set_volatile_mode: set an RL model to volatile inference mode to skip saving history
